caption_L1: This bar diagram is called Private data stored on digital devices according to internet users worldwide as of June 2015. The y-axis plots Share of respondents while the x-axis plots Response.
caption_L2L3: Approximately 10% of respondents store every category of data on digital devices. The type of data least likely to be stored on a digital device is passwords for work VPN/intranet.
